review.images: Reviewed the wide hero and all images from the exact Emaar project gallery. Kept distinct published scenes with a project-specific listing image and readable interior views.
review.location: Matched the developer’s named project point and the regional map from physical page 4 of the official brochure. Verified the four printed brochure times. The launch sheet’s alternate Downtown and airport times are disclosed separately.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all 46 physical pages. Kept 44 residence sheets including 38 apartment plans and six townhouse sheets for nine townhouses. Checked 28 single totals against their components within 0.01 sq ft. Kept the 16 published ranges without inferring individual component pairings. Pier Point 2’s fact-sheet and floor-plan townhouse ranges conflict and are both qualified. Original physical pages and hosting attribution remain linked.

unavailable: A corrected Pier Point 2 townhouse fact sheet and developer-hosted copies of the full Pier Point 2 apartment and townhouse packs were not verified.
Signed unit-specific areas and entrance coordinates were not verified.
